run_gtest_shuffle_test: run the gtest_shuffle_test_ program with custom environment variables and CLI flags to verify test shuffling
create_gtest_filter_flag: create a gtest filter flag string like --gtest_filter=A*.A:A*.B:C* to select specific tests
build_gtest_shuffle_flag: build the --gtest_shuffle flag string to enable random test ordering in Google Test
test_GetTestsForAllIterations: test the GetTestsForAllIterations function to parse test output into a list of test lists per iteration
summarize_GetTestCases: summarize the GetTestCases function which extracts unique test case names from full test names in original order
